solutions.title: Full DFS count
solutions.strategy: Count the current node plus counts from both children.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion stack grows with tree height h.

solutions.title: Complete-tree height pruning
solutions.strategy: Compare leftmost heights to count perfect subtrees in one step.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each recursive level computes two left heights, and a complete tree has logarithmic height.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursive stack follows one branch per level.
